summary: Israeli airstrikes hit three settlements in southern Lebanon (Mansouri, Qantara, Kfartoubnine) alongside artillery bombardment. A UAV strike occurred in northern Gaza. Senior Houthi commander Gen. Firaq Mohsen al-Assar was killed at Kahboub front near Bab al-Mandab. Iran's Basij held mobilization exercise in Tehran claiming US forces will soon withdraw from the region.
key_points: Israeli aerial and artillery strikes targeted Mansouri, Qantara, and Kfartoubnine in southern Lebanon simultaneously (Source: @SharghDaily/184483)
UAV strike reported in northern Gaza with no further details on casualties or damage (Source: @shin_persian/10170)
Houthi senior commander Gen. Firaq Mohsen al-Assar and six guards killed at Kahboub front near Bab al-Mandab Strait; he commanded the 1st Commando Brigade (Source: @shin_persian/10187)

Iran's Basij "313 Volunteers" exercise held in Tehran, route Imam Hossein Square to Revolution Square; training in land, air, and sea domains; hundreds of thousands registered (Source: @VahidOnline/78434)
US officials tell Washington Post that 22-3 soldiers killed in Iran war, not 18 as Pentagon claims; 3 contractors also killed, circumstances undisclosed (Source: @asafroz/53550)
Power station targeted on Baghdad-Hilla road northwest of Iraq; no further details (Source: @naya_foriraq/90905)
Significant decrease in hostile drone activity reported in Lebanon compared to previous days, movement remains very limited (Source: @redlinkleb/43656)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli strikes hit three southern Lebanese settlements (Mansouri, Qantara, Kfartoubnine) with aircraft and artillery. sections.threat_assessment: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanese settlements combined with artillery indicate expanding operations beyond initial targets. Houthi leadership degradation at Kahboub front may disrupt Red Sea operations. Iran's Basij mobilization exercise with hundreds of thousands and claims of imminent US withdrawal suggest escalation signaling. USAF tankers in region support potential extended operations. Discrepancy in US casualty figures (22-23 vs 18) suggests information management issues.
sections.regional_response: Pakistan requested Iran intervene in Yemen to stop Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure; Iran refused, calling it Saudi-Yemeni matter. Turkey formally closed Bank Melli Istanbul branch, completing financial isolation of Iranian state bank. South Korea dropped Hormuz deployment plan. JPMorgan analysts unable to forecast oil prices amid US-Iran war uncertainty, indicating economic instability.
sections.intelligence_notes: UAV strike in northern Gaza and simultaneous strikes in southern Lebanon suggest coordinated multi-front operations. Decrease in Lebanese drone activity may indicate Houthi supply chain disruption or tactical pause. Explosion reported near northeast Tehran requires monitoring. Real-time mapping of Kfartoubnite artillery and southern Lebanon fighter jets indicates active targeting cycle. Adra prison official sentenced in US may signal broader accountability efforts for Syrian regime figures.
